== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Loial]]}}
Loial reminisces about his experiences with humans outside the ''[[stedding]], ''and admits to himself that he always secretly wished to be hasty. He wonders at the brevity of human life, and how exciting it must be.  

His attention turns to the woods as he walks with [[Erith]], [[Haman|Elder Haman,]] and a large force of [[Ogier]] armed with axes. He thinks of the wood dying around him, and how the [[Trolloc|Trollocs]] and the [[Dark One]]'s touch have killed many beautiful trees. His anger rises as he spots a Fist of Trollocs. 

As the Ogier begin their war song, he joins his voice with theirs while slaying Trollocs.

:{{pov|[[Galadedrid Damodred]]}}
Galad watches the Ogier fight as his forces retreat through the woods. The [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]] and [[Andoran]] forces are stunned at the brutality with which the Ogier slaughter the [[Shadowspawn]]. [[Berab Golever|Golever]] argues that the Ogier are [[Darkfriend|Darkfriends]] running a scheme to get their trust. [[Trom]] tells him not to be a fool and Galad, unconvinced by Golever's arguments, tells them to gather their wounded.

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
[[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] explains how she used to spend so much time trying to figure out what goes on in Rand's head and he admits that he should have trusted her. To illustrate that he does now, he shares his plan for confronting the Dark One: He intends to kill ''[[Shai'tan]]''. Moiraine argues with Rand, saying that the Dark One is an integral part of the Pattern and is beyond killing. Rand counters that the Dark One exists outside the pattern, and therefore can be slain, but first Rand must go to [[Ebou Dar]] to meet with the [[Seanchan]] and bring them to his side. Moiraine tells him that the pact is simply a piece of paper and it is distracting him from his goal, but Rand says "we will see."

:{{pov|[[Moiraine Damodred]]}}
Moiraine thinks on how Rand is an odd mixture of self-effacement and pride. She sips tea that was prepared by Rand and is therefore more fragrant and tasteful than it had been in even before the supplies started to spoil.

:{{pov|[[Al'Lan Mandragoran]]}}
[[Andere]] carries the banner of [[Malkier]] as he and Lan are joined by more Malkieri. Lan sees the smoke from [[Fal Dara]] and [[Fal Moran]], the two grandest cities in [[Shienar]], which were torched by their own people to avoid providing any sustenance to the Trollocs. Lan and his fellow soldiers fight through the ranks of Trollocs even as the battle descends into chaos. He sees Andere on the ground, along with the banner, and Lan takes down two [[Myrddraal|Fades]], killing fifty Trollocs that were linked to them. Andere is still alive but with a head injury and his arm is hanging at an odd angle. Lan asks Deepe to send the signal of a red streak of light to indicate the forces should retreat. Lan has [[Deepe Bhadar|Deepe]] check on Andere. Deepe reports various injuries, but heals Andere's head wound and he comes to his senses.

Prince [[Kaisel Noramaga|Kaisel]] points out the [[Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi|Queen of Saldaea]] marching into battle. The Prince doesn't approve, but Lan assures him that Saldaean women are quite tough.

The battle has finally broken off and the Trollocs flood the field searching for anything to eat; even their own dead. Lan concludes this is the time to attack and Lord [[Agelmar Jagad|Agelmar]] clearly agrees as a yellow streak of light rises as the signal for the troops to return to the field and slaughter the hungry Trollocs. The [[Dreadlords]] realize what is happening and re-engage the Borderlander forces. Deepe realizes the [[M'Hael]] is with them and attempts to fight him over Lan's protests. A pair of lightning bolts unnerve Mandarb and Lan is thrown off. He is rescued by Prince Kaisel, but looks back to see the mangled body of Deepe.
